results.content: President Donald Trump’s approval rating has fallen to 33 percent in the latest Economist/YouGov poll, marking his lowest approval in YouGov tracking across both his first and second terms. The survey, conducted August 7–10, 2026, found that 62 percent of Americans disapprove of his job performance, giving Trump a net approval rating of -29, also the lowest he has ever recorded. [...] The collapse in support spans demographic groups that once backed Trump. Among independents, his net approval stands at -53, a dramatic swing from -28 at the start of 2026.
